rules.source: original81 banks only; all3887 queries x3 references =11661 query uses
rules.GT_use: explicit posthoc original-resolution region masks and diagnostic AUC; not method input
rules.sampling: max8192 pixels per GT stratum; SHA256 identity seed; same pixels across methods/layers/references
rules.region_statistics: all original-resolution pixels including zeros under unchanged masks
rules.quality_proxy: sampled per-image layer AUC; normal-only or all-defect images have null AUC
rules.alignment: dot(mean layer weights, per-image layer AUCs) - mean(layer AUCs); descriptive GLOBAL proxy, NOT proof of local reliability
rules.averaging: images within category/reference/kind, then equal categories, then equal references; missing counts retained
rules.interpretation: score decrease is NOT false-positive reduction; sampled AUC is NOT official global P-AUROC/AUPRO
rules.GT_metadata: MVTec requires explicit matching H/W; VisA may omit BOTH; original image H/W remains authoritative and decoded GT must match exactly
